summary: This 6-K filing by Kanzhun Ltd (HKEX stock code 02076) reports a Next Day Disclosure Return pursuant to HKEX Main Board Rule 13.25A, detailing multiple tranches of on-market share repurchases for cancellation from March 20 through April 15, 2026. The repurchases cover approximately 12.7M Class A ordinary shares at a weighted average price around USD 6.68, representing about 1.5% of existing issued shares. The company acts as issuer buying back its own shares, with all repurchased shares held for cancellation. This is a textbook capital return via share buyback, not a tender offer, as the purchases are open-market and ongoing.
